main.description: Pause or resume the autoscaler. Pausing stops new host requests; one under way carries on. Staff only.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID. Repeating a request with the same key replays its answer.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not HappyProto staff, or the provisioner does not treat them as staff.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input was malformed, or the provisioner refused it as malformed.

errors.name: NotRetryable
errors.description: Only a failed request can be retried.

errors.name: NotCancellable
errors.description: A registered or cancelled request cannot be cancelled.

errors.name: RequestInFlight
errors.description: Another host request is under way.

errors.name: ScalerNotConfigured
errors.description: The provisioner has no GitHub App to start workflows with.

errors.name: HostRegistered
errors.description: The request's host already has a host row: retire it, or set it active and leave the request. The message says which.

errors.name: ConfirmationMismatch
errors.description: confirm is not the request's host name.

errors.name: DispatchFailed
errors.description: GitHub would not start the workflow. The request is unchanged.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
